news.title: The 10-year Treasury yield is at its highest in nearly two decades. How we got here
news.summary: The benchmark yield has climbed to a 19-year high, fueled by sticky inflation, heavy bond issuance and an AI-fueled investment boom.

news.title: Apple faces $5.7 billion patent infringement verdict over iPhone and Apple Watch haptics
news.summary: A federal jury awarded Taction Technology more than $5.7 billion after finding Apple infringed claims from two haptics patents. Apple plans to appeal.

news.title: Trump, Xi wrap state visit centered on spectacle over substance. Here are the top takeaways
news.summary: President Trump and Chinese leader Xi went heavy on the ceremony and light on deliverables. They danced around Taiwan and Iran during two days in Washington.

news.title: Trump rejects Iran's conditional ceasefire proposal, WSJ reports, as Saudi coalition intercepts projectiles
news.summary: Trump expects renewed U.S. bombing of Iran after the midterm elections. Saudi-backed forces intercept projectiles, The Wall Street Journal reports.

news.title: Airlines waive change fees ahead of nor'easter as flight disruptions trickle in
news.summary: Flight disruptions are rising in Boston for Saturday. Flight delays are expected to continue into Sunday. Flight disruptions are also expected in New York City and Washington.

news.title: Choosing these AI-exposed college majors could dent your job prospects — and lower your pay
news.summary: New findings supply hard data on the potential costs of these decisions. At a time when many college students say they are rethinking their academic focus because of AI, these findings provide hard data.

news.title: Tax-free bond yields are in a sweet spot. Get in before it’s too late.
news.summary: Yields on municipal bonds — adjusted for taxable-equivalent comparisons — have widened dramatically over those of corporate bonds over the past two months.

news.title: ‘She says it’s just money’: My friend pays for everything. I should be grateful, but I can’t stand her anymore.
news.summary: “On each of these weekends away, she’s probably spending $500,” says her father. “She probably spends $500 on each weekend.”

news.title: Millions will lose Medicaid once new work rules kick in. These groups will be hit the hardest.
news.summary: The changes will cut about $1 trillion from federal Medicaid spending over 10 years. The changes are expected to be implemented by the end of the year.

news.title: ‘We lived within our means’: I earned $30,000 as a pastor and still retired comfortably. Why don’t you tell people that?
news.summary: “As a country, we have grown dangerously comfortable,” he said. “We have growndangerously comfortable.”
